title: Coati dataset document
description: Everything a netCDF or HDF5 file holds: groups, dimensions, variables and attributes, with the values. The layout follows the data model of netCDF.

schema_version.description: The version of the layout of this document.

warnings.description: What the reader could not represent, such as a link into another file.

generator.description: The program that wrote the document.

source.description: The file the document was made from.

name.description: The name of the file, without its directory.

size.description: The size of the file in bytes.

properties.description: What the file says about the software that wrote it.

attributes.description: The attributes by name. A value is text, a number, a truth value, null, a list of these or, with decoded text, the document that a text holds.

dimensions.description: The dimensions that a group defines, by name.

unlimited.description: Whether the dimension may grow, as that of records does.

variables.description: The variables of a group, by name.

groups.description: The groups within a group, by name.

dtype.description: The type of the values: that of NumPy for numbers, such as float64, or string, char, bool, datetime, compound, opaque, reference or vlen<...>.

dimensions.description: The name of the dimension of each axis; null for an axis without one, which occurs in HDF5 files that are not netCDF.

encoding.description: The attributes that the interpretation of the values has consumed, such as units and _FillValue.

enumeration.description: For a variable of an enumerated type, the name of each value.

data.description: The values: nested lists with one level for each axis, or a single value for a variable without axes.

data_omitted.description: Present and true if the values were left out because the variable has more elements than the limit.
